text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The dust settles on this fated matchup,
and
Daiwa Scarlet emerges victorious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Huff... Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Puff... Huff... Sigh... I couldn't pull it off... But still...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Now, that was intense!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You were so close, Machan! I've still got
chills
from watching you!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Same! I'm so, so glad I came to watch!

Great job, Machan! Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm number one...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes! I did it! I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm number one!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Damn... Damn, damn, damn!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I lost the rematch! That's so damn lame! Sniffle!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely gonna win next time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho comes to a close, leaving
almost no
heart untouched.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm waiting for Aston Machan to finish
packing
up her things, I get a
notification on my phone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a message from the blog saying that
our views
have suddenly skyrocketed
today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if this is because of the Oka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wonderful. It appears I've left my mark.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm going to go say hi to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess she's going to talk to the others
who ran
today? She heads out without
waiting for a
response, so I decide to
wait for her to return in
her own time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (I can still hear it if I close my eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(I can hear that beautiful sound, and see
that
beautiful scenery. I may have lost,
but we had a
beautiful race.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Splendid. Absolutely splendid.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now, everyone... I ask that you hold this
memory
tight.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hold it tight and treasure it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Machan, signing off.
